blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Free rides will be offered at the Light Rail Transit 1 (LRT-1) on November 9 (Monday), 11 (Wednesday) and 13 (Friday). This comes amid road closures for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. According to the Department of Tourism (DOT), commuters may avail of the free rides next week on the LRT-1 on these dates from 7 a.m. to 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. “Enjoy free rides on LRT-1 on November 9, 11, and 13 (7:00 AM to 9:00 AM; 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM) as we celebrate the ASEAN Summit,” the […]...
